name: Deep Cleaning
short: A top-to-bottom clean that tackles dirt, grime, and buildup. Ideal for first-time cleanings or seasonal resets.
intro: Our deep clean goes beyond the surface. We scrub, detail, and reset every room so your home starts fresh, then routine cleans keep it that way.
bestFor: Homes that haven't been professionally cleaned recently

name: Routine Cleaning
short: Perfect if you're switching from another cleaner or just had a deep clean. Save up to 40% with recurring cleans.
intro: Weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly visits from the same trusted cleaner, with a thoughtful rotation so overlooked areas never build up.

name: Move In/Out Cleaning
short: Prepare your home for its next chapter, whether you're moving in, moving out, or getting ready to sell.
intro: An empty-home clean that covers the inside of cabinets, drawers, closets, and appliances, so the space is truly ready for whoever comes next.
